svg.title: NMF: a preamble of five records
svg.desc: The preamble of frame 4 of terrain_nmf_censure.pcap, 32 bits per row, five records one after the other, each opened by its type byte: a Version record, type 0x00, major 1 and minor 0; a Mode record, type 0x01, mode 2 for Duplex; a Via record, type 0x02, a size of 41 on one byte and a 41-byte URI that starts with net.tcp://host/, censored; a Known Encoding record, type 0x03, encoding 8; and a Preamble End record, the single byte 0x0C; NmfSegment gives the five records in wire order, the URI as a borrowed string.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
